title: Biomagnification and the Ozone Layer
summary: How non-biodegradable chemicals build up in food chains, and how the ozone layer was damaged and is recovering.
objectives: I can explain why the ozone layer matters.
I can describe how CFCs damaged it and how the world responded.
misconceptions: Pesticides are diluted as they pass up a food chain.
The ozone hole causes global warming.
Ozone is good wherever it is.
